note: Ceilings on the top-to-bottom generator scripts and the two tools that grew with them. Written by tools/line-ratchet.js --accept; read by the same tool in CI. A file may not exceed its ceiling; raising one is a reviewed change committed WITH the growth it accepts. Why: buses-data OA-224 Tier 2.1 -- gen_internal.js went 2,550 -> 3,293 lines in the five days after the refactor that cut it, because the module-first rule (OA-001) had no instrument. From 2026-09-04 a RAISE must say why: --accept refuses a file over its ceiling without --note "<path>=<text>" (or --note-file), and appends that text as a dated paragraph to the optional "notes" block below, keyed by the same path as "files". The tool writes the note; never type one into this file by hand, which is how the quality ledger came to have five commits that each rewrote 460 of its 468 lines. Ratcheting DOWN needs no note.
